# Rade & Co Publishing

> Independent publisher of planners, children's books, journals, and specialty titles by author Kate Rade. Books are sold on Amazon.

Rade & Co Publishing was founded by author Kate Rade. The catalog includes professional planners (Travel Agent Planner, Photography Planner), family titles (True or False Vol. 1 and classic-inspired storybooks), journals (Coloring Mindfulness Journal), and specialty books (My Baking Secrets, The Ultimate Off-Road Adventures Handbook). This file is a concise guide for AI systems looking for the most useful pages and current catalog content.

## Books
- [Travel Agent Planner](https://radeandcopublishing.cloud/books/travel-agent-planner.html): A practical planner for travel professionals who need client details, bookings, and itinerary planning in one place.
- [Travel Agent Planner (Green Edition)](https://radeandcopublishing.cloud/books/travel-agent-planner-green.html): Green cover edition of the Travel Agent Planner, a 24-month undated planner for clients, bookings, income, vendors, and taxes.
- [Travel Agent Planner (Blue Edition)](https://radeandcopublishing.cloud/books/travel-agent-planner-blue.html): Blue cover edition of the Travel Agent Planner, an undated, two-year planner for clients, bookings, income, vendors, and taxes.
- [Photography Planner](https://radeandcopublishing.cloud/books/photography-planner.html): A planner for photographers managing shoots, timelines, and creative prep.
- [True or False Vol. 1](https://radeandcopublishing.cloud/books/true-or-false-vol-1.html): A bright, game-style family title packed with playful true or false challenges.
- [The Little Mermaid](https://radeandcopublishing.cloud/books/the-little-mermaid.html): A timeless children's classic presented with warm, shelf-friendly appeal.
- [Thumbelina](https://radeandcopublishing.cloud/books/thumbelina.html): A whimsical children's title with classic fairy-tale warmth.
- [The Princess and the Pea](https://radeandcopublishing.cloud/books/the-princess-and-the-pea.html): A gentle, classic-inspired children's story for shared reading.
- [Coloring Mindfulness Journal](https://radeandcopublishing.cloud/books/coloring-mindfulness-journal.html): A calming journal that blends coloring with structured writing space.
- [My Baking Secrets](https://radeandcopublishing.cloud/books/my-baking-secrets.html): A recipe and baking-notes book for keeping favorite bakes in one place.
- [The Ultimate Off-Road Adventures Handbook](https://radeandcopublishing.cloud/books/the-ultimate-off-road-adventures-handbook.html): A handbook for documenting trails, trips, and off-road adventures.
